'''Sherman''' (Japanese: '''バリー''' ''Barry'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY008|Grooming Furfrou!]]''. He is a famous [[Pokémon groomer]] who grooms several {{p|Furfrou}} in his shop. He is currently teaching his young apprentice {{OBP|Jessica|XY008}} in the art of grooming Pokémon.

Sherman first appeared in {{an|Serena}}'s travel guide, and {{ashfr|the group}} were excited to meet Sherman in person after encountering Jessica. Seeing Serena and {{an|Bonnie}}'s excitement, he suggested Jessica offer them on a grand tour of the salon. Sherman also showcased some of his clients, including Furfrou with a [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Furfrou|Diamond, the Kabuki and La Reine Trims]]. Sherman is humble in spite ofhis superstar groomer status. He was well aware of Jessica's struggles with her own Furfrou's stubborness, but reminded her to be patient while they tried to bond. Following the demonstration, Sherman recommended Jessica to take {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} on a tour around the city.

Later, he proudly watched Jessica style her Furfrou with a Heart Trim after they both bonded with each other.
